run_uncompress_s2ef_datasets: run the uncompress script to decompress S2EF dataset files from a compressed directory to an output directory
run_lzma_decompression_with_workers: run the uncompress script with multiple workers to parallelize decompressing txt.xz and extxyz.xz files
create_lzma_decompress_function: create a function that reads an lzma compressed file and writes the decompressed contents to an output file
review_read_lzma_function: review the read_lzma function that decompresses a single lzma file and writes output to disk
test_decompress_list_of_files: test the decompress_list_of_files function that takes an input-output file pair tuple and decompresses it
